lists.content:
• Manage and grow a diverse portfolio of clients across corporate brands, advertising agencies, and production companies.
  • Map account structures, identify new stakeholders, and expand relationships across creative, production, procurement, and marketing teams.
  • Conduct discovery meetings to understand clients' content pipelines, creative workflows, and business objectives.
  • Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities across stock content, custom content, editorial assets, and AI-powered tools.
  • Proactively pursue new business opportunities, especially within fast-growing agencies, emerging production houses, and innovative corporate brands.
  • Maintain a consistent rhythm of outreach and client engagement, targeting 25+ discovery or solution-oriented meetings per month.
  • Deliver impactful virtual and in-person presentations tailored to each client segment.
  • Guide clients through the full Getty Images ecosystem, positioning the company as a strategic partner rather than a transactional vendor.
  • Build customized proposals aligned with client budgets, campaign timelines, and industry-specific needs (e.g., retail, tech, finance, entertainment, lifestyle).
  • Lead pricing, renewal, negotiation, and conversations with confidence and clarity.
  • Use Salesforce daily to manage your pipeline, update account information, and track meeting activity.
  • Maintain accurate forecasts and communicate progress on active opportunities and long-term growth plans.
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams across Legal, Product, Content, and Marketing to deliver seamless customer experiences.
  • Stay informed on trends in content creation, licensing, AI innovation, and regional market dynamics.
  • Share insights, learnings, and winning approaches to strengthen the LATAM sales team.

• 3–5 years of B2B sales experience, preferably selling media, content licensing, SaaS, creative services, or marketing solutions.
  • Experience working with international companies or multicultural environments.
  • Deep understanding of the Brazilian creative, corporate, and production ecosystem, especially within mid-market and enterprise segments.
  • Strong relationship-building capabilities across creative directors, producers, account managers, brand teams, and procurement.
  • Experience with CRM and sales tools such as Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Outreach (or equivalents).
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both virtually and in person.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (written and verbal).
  • Ability to navigate value-sensitive environments, providing consultative solutions that balance creativity, impact, and budget considerations.

descriptionPlain:
At Unsplash we’re enabling everyone to create by making visuals easily accessible to all creators, both big and small. Today, Unsplash powers more people and products than any other visual search engine in the world. Our team builds unsplash.com, Unsplash for iOS, and the Unsplash API, directly powering over 10,000+ applications including: Medium, BuzzFeed, Facebook, Squarespace, Google, Trello, and Square. 
We build tools and features for both the free Unsplash library and the premium Unsplash+ library—a subscription product that supports Unsplash and the community of contributors. 
We’re depended on every day as a fundamental building block in the creative process, allowing anyone, from students to award-winning creators, access to high-quality, usable imagery. Our team is made up of people who enjoy making things people love. We care about details and we care about quality. We do more with less. We’re open and transparent about everything we do, both internally and externally.

  • Comfortable leading a team, and being responsible for the growth, development and performance of team members.
  • Expert in front-end technologies incl. Node, TypeScript, React, Next.js
  • Experience building web applications at scale
  • Experience with functional programming

Meaningful experience building features related to:
  • Search
  • SEO
  • Ecommerce

lists.content:
• You seek out and develop new revenue streams within target segments and customers as it relates to Getty Images’ commercial strategy and all its products and services, enabling sustainable financial growth.
  • Are you adept in utilising a combination of sales, strategy and deal making experience in order to identify and build relationships with senior stakeholders across the sport, entertainment, culture and corporate sectors? If this is the case, then you can be part of a phenomenal opportunity within the region!
  • Previous experience operating within the KSA is crucial to the role.
  • The successful candidate is self-directed, results-oriented, and comfortable working across different sectors, products and cultures.

• Build a target list of leads in their target segment/organizations and purposefully track down opportunities.
  • Acquire a thorough understanding of customer needs and requirements, including interactions with our competitors.
  • Aggressively sell to these leads, building lasting professional relationships with new contacts up to C-suite level by proposing solutions or bundles of solutions that meet their needs.
  • Demonstrate consistent daily habits of progressing leads through sales stages including implementing detailed next steps for each opportunity.
  • Demonstrate a strategic approach to developing the target segment or customer, looking beyond short-term targets to build a pipeline of sufficient size to exceed budget.
  • Implement business strategy across the target segment whether cross-selling, upselling, discount management, optimally raising pricing or bringing new, fee-based products or features to market.
  • Author detailed selling plans minimum twice yearly, outlining specific targets, contact strategy, KPIs for success and points of adjustment.
  • Consistently deliver required business reports accurately and on time
  • Meet required monthly Salesforce CRM KPIs.
  • Upload a forecast (Outlook) that is +/-10% of what is delivered in the month.

• Sell in a systematic, methodological way using a process driven approach.
  • Proven experience (minimum 3 years) using Salesforce or equivalent CRM system.
  • Demonstrated experience of and comfort with Salesforce Engage, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or equivalent tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Well-developed time management and organization skills.
  • Commercially aware and data numerate.
  • Competent in use of Excel and other reporting tools
  • Skilled networker, able to reach senior and C-suite contacts.
  • Effective, influential communicator with strong interpersonal skills able to engage effectively through all media, from in-person to virtual.
  • Collaborates effectively with internal Getty Images SMEs and colleagues in other segments/departments.
  • At least 7 years of sales representative experience in a SaaS or Consumer Goods environment is preferred.
  • Can quickly acquire or has developed an industry understanding.
  • Self-starting, proactive, self-motivated, works effectively with minimal supervision.
  • Brings curiosity and inquisitiveness to interactions with potential customers.
  • Empathetic, with well-developed active listening as well as questioning skills
  • Demonstrates a growth mindset through commitment to continuous professional development; seeks regular coaching and feedback on customer interactions (in person or recorded)
  • Driven to succeed and competitive: circumvents barriers, consistently aiming to exceed 100%.
  • Leads by example and “pays it forward” by embodying sales professional best practice and mentoring other sales employees

descriptionPlain:
The Creative team provides customers with original, relevant, and contemporary visuals. Through an industry-unique combination of consumer research, proprietary data, and three decades of trend reporting experience, the team delivers actionable insights that guide customers to the visual content that connects with consumers. Closely collaborating with our contributor base of photographers, videographers, and illustrators around the world, the team develops market leading, authentic, and differentiated content. 
 
Who You Are:
You are a fluent Japanese and English speaker who is passionate about the way imagery works. You are naturally interested in visual communication in all forms and love discussing the content that you come across. You are equal parts creative and analytical. You enjoy research and are comfortable sharing what you know with the world at large. You are highly organized and detail-oriented, able to manage the moving parts of multiple work streams operating simultaneously while still meeting deadlines. You are a creative problem-solver with the ability to quickly identify problems and work independently to find appropriate solutions. You have a pulse on what’s new and next in art and culture and are not afraid to share your insights and perspective with a multi-disciplinary creative team.

lists.content:
• Research & Analysis
  • Create subject-area lightboxes in our proprietary content management system to support content analysis.
  • Conduct qualitative visual analysis of multi-format creative content, identifying themes/patterns to determine content needs and opportunities.
  • Interpret proprietary search and sales data to identify and anticipate directional shifts in customer interests and content needs.
  • Work with Sales partners and Research teams to collect and collate relevant customer feedback on creative content.
  • Find and archive relevant tear sheets/swipes from marketing/advertising and related industry publications.
  • Mine external sources such as consumer research databases, world news, pop culture, advertising, fine art/photography for unique insights that will help internal and external partners understand how shifts in the global landscape will impact creative content.
  • Support the broader Creative Insights team in synthesizing findings to be presented to internal and external audiences.
  • Sales, Marketing & PR Support
  • Collaborate with global and regional marketing teams to grow key accounts by providing insights on visual trends impacting their business.
  • Write insightful thought-leadership pieces for the Getty creative insights page that positions creative offerings as cutting-edge, high quality and industry-leading.
  • Assist and/or lead the creation of customer-facing presentations about harnessing visual trends to fuel powerful brand storytelling.
  • Create themed visual boards and compile related data for marketing, PR-teams and site merchandising to utilize throughout the year for promotion.
  • Attend seminars, panel discussions and media interviews as needed.

  • Support content development specialists and managers in shoot planning by providing context on visual trends and industry needs
  • Prepare presentations to disseminate visual trends to contributors in-person or virtually.

• Must be a fluent Japanese and English speaker

  • Experience thriving in a fast-moving, dynamic creative environment.
  • Proficiency in relevant software applications, particularly Microsoft PowerPoint (and/or Keynote) and Excel.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex ideas to different audiences.
  • Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize and interpret large amounts of qualitative and quantitative data.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple distinct projects at the same time.
  • Positive, collaborative attitude with a passion for creative excellence.
  • Ability to balance being a key partner, who is empathic towards their peers and seeks consensus, with being a strong advocate and champion for data-driven decision making.
  • Experience thriving in a fast-moving, dynamic creative environment.
  • Proficiency in relevant software applications, particularly Microsoft PowerPoint (and/or Keynote) and Excel.

descriptionBody:
The Creative team provides customers with original, relevant, and contemporary visuals. Through an industry-unique combination of consumer research, proprietary data, and three decades of trend reporting experience, the team delivers actionable insights that guide customers to the visual content that connects with consumers. Closely collaborating with our contributor base of photographers, videographers, and illustrators around the world, the team develops market leading, authentic, and differentiated content. 
 
Who You Are:
You are a fluent Japanese and English speaker who is passionate about the way imagery works. You are naturally interested in visual communication in all forms and love discussing the content that you come across. You are equal parts creative and analytical. You enjoy research and are comfortable sharing what you know with the world at large. You are highly organized and detail-oriented, able to manage the moving parts of multiple work streams operating simultaneously while still meeting deadlines. You are a creative problem-solver with the ability to quickly identify problems and work independently to find appropriate solutions. You have a pulse on what’s new and next in art and culture and are not afraid to share your insights and perspective with a multi-disciplinary creative team.
 
This is a fixed term role with a duration of one year.
